scope: authored complete PCM before any music feature inspection

context.ownership: fixed overlap midpoint; later context owns the exact seam; no blend or context chosen by scores
context.tail: unpadded, 4..8 seconds except single-context short input; stop once last context covers the complete input

rule.formula: mean cosine full previous candidate cycle minus cosine previous half cycle
rule.comparison_to_prehead: same formula, direction and numerical budgets; different fixed representation, grid and context, not a layer or metric sweep
rule.interpolation: both raw endpoints in float64, then unit normalize; no 50 Hz feature reconstruction
rule.common_support: all eight clocks share integer target frames and both endpoints entirely inside the four-second window
rule.phase: absolute and half-density phase cancel analytically; keep both half names, never count duplicate phases as votes
rule.unavailable: no common support or any required zero norm rejects the whole window and both paired verdicts
rule.meaning: oracle-supplied clocks; labels absent from scoring does not mean automatic tempo/change discovery

authored.synthesis: float64 at 24 kHz then float32 PCM; phase continuous at 6s; cue 0.04*(1+cos(2*pi*phase))*sin(2*pi*220*t); pulse 0.3*amplitude*exp(-age/0.015)*(age<0.08)*sin(2*pi*880*age); age is fractional phase times local period; alternate pulse amplitude 0 or 1/8 in omission/weak cases; silence all zero
authored.hidden_controls: separate authored phase-circle vectors with third-channel weak/omitted pulses, flat/zero and density counterexamples; never reported as neural features
authored.pairing: each of three constant conditions against both fast and slow changes, all retained; shared changes are not independent songs
authored.seam: true change deliberately on fixed 6s ownership seam; second seam at 10s; all samples processed

future_calibration: retain seven original ARTBeaT pairs, four original phase conditions and old geometry guards; all forty IDs accounted; RUBATO expressive/untyped; map each old physical four-second interval to its 100 native 25 Hz centers, with explicit 0/20ms initial offset; resampling/PCM provenance gate still required before any music inference
decision: any authored paired shape/density failure or silence clock spread above numerical tie closes this fixed rule before music; extraction fidelity is reported independently; no threshold/layer/context/recipe changes after feature inspection
resources: reuse 4 GiB Windows CPU job, two threads and minimum free resource gates; bounded parent timeout 900 seconds for 54 forwards, not a latency target
